title: Company objective weave and critical path maps
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Create a single canonical artifact (the 'Objective Weave') that maps high-level company OKRs to the set of cross-team initiatives, milestone-level deliverables, and their critical-path dependencies for the upcoming two quarters. The deliverable will include: 1) a visual topology (Miro) that shows objective -> initiative -> milestone relationships and dependency edges; 2) a lightweight decision/risk register for each critical dependency with owners and mitigations; 3) a rollout timeline aligned to release gates and major sales/marketing events; 4) an owner/RACI for handoffs between Platform (runtime), Console, and Dedicated/Private delivery tracks. This ticket covers scoping, stakeholder interviews, template creation, and a pilot run with two complex initiatives (runtime kernel scheduling improvements and Dedicated autoscaling UX). The goal is to reduce cross-team misalignment and late dependency escalations that have caused scope slippage in prior quarters.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical Objective Weave Miro board exists with top-level OKRs and linked initiatives
Each critical dependency has an assigned owner, mitigation plan, and success metric
Pilot run completed with runtime and dedicated teams; feedback logged and incorporated
Hand-off RACI and milestone-level timeline published to Confluence and referenced from each initiative ticket
Stakeholder sign-off (VP Product, Head of Eng, Program Manager) captured in comments
